info.title: PoYo AI - GPT Image 2.5 Flare API
info.description: The GPT Image 2.5 Flare API generates one image from a prompt or edits up to 16 reference images. It is the faster GPT Image 2.5 option and supports masks, transparent backgrounds, and 1K to 4K output.

post.description: GPT Image 2.5 Flare single-image generation and reference-image editing with background, format, and mask controls.

input.prompt: A premium product photo of a silver espresso machine in a bright studio
Keep the product and replace the background with a warm modern studio
Replace only the masked area with a small vase of flowers
A clean cutout of a small silver robot

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure.

input.description: Generate one image, or edit reference images when image_urls is non-empty.

prompt.description: Prompt describing the image or the requested edit. Must contain non-whitespace text.

image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs. A non-empty array selects editing; an omitted or empty array selects text-to-image generation. Must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.

size.description: Aspect ratio or custom WIDTHxHEIGHT. Supported values: auto, 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 4:3, 3:4, 4:5, 5:4, 16:9, 9:16, 21:9, or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Defaults to 1:1. auto is available only at 1K. Custom sizes require resolution 2K or 4K, dimensions divisible by 16, max edge 3840, aspect ratio at most 3:1, and total pixels 655360–8294400. A custom 3840-pixel edge requires 4K.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. For aspect ratios, actual pixel dimensions may vary by model and generation; inspect the returned image for exact dimensions. Custom WIDTHxHEIGHT specifies exact dimensions.

background.description: Background mode. transparent requires png or webp output.

mask_url.description: Optional mask image URL identifying the area to edit. Requires non-empty image_urls. Must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
